newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 26.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Listing of new shares on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchange will hit a peak on Thursday with a total of 480 million new shares making their debut, the largest number of new shares listed on China's markets a single day.

- State banks have shifted most of their state debt positions to the China central state debt depository in line with Beijing's order that all state debt positions be deposited at the depository to check trading irregularities.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Hong Kong companies have become the major source of fund supply in re-constructing Huaihai Road, one of Shanghai's most important downtown commercial streets.
- Commentary says price cuts by television makers are not a good way to improve China's television industry and mergers and cooperation among producers are needed.
